selection.reason: The request matches support-deflection: keyword-matched tickets get a hand-written FAQ reply, and all other and urgent tickets go to a person in one digest.
notCovered: The digest is to go to mike@fitzone.com on a daily schedule; the template's digest recipient and schedule must be configured to match this.
The shipping FAQ answer text must be supplied by the user as the reply they wrote.

answers.reply: Thanks for contacting us about shipping. Our shipping FAQ answers this question. If it does not solve your issue, reply to this e-mail and we will help you further.

workflow.title: Support ticket answers and escalation
workflow.goal: Each run, answer the open, non-urgent tickets that mention a known keyword with the person's reply for it, and send every other open ticket to mike@fitzone.com in one digest, after a person approves each e-mail.

assumptions: The tickets sheet holds one row per ticket with id, from, subject, body, priority and status
Delivery is a local outbox file standing in for e-mail; nothing leaves this machine
risks: An urgent or unusual ticket answered by a canned reply
successCriteria: Every open ticket was either answered with a matching reply or sent to the person
No urgent ticket was answered automatically
This run delivered exactly the planned e-mails, each intact (checked by re-reading the outbox)
unsupported: Running on a schedule by itself
